# Import data and wrangle

```{r}

subjDataPath <- utils::choose.files(caption=r"(Select refmap_listest1_2_testdataMerge_BySubj.csv from 03 Experiment\Experiment_1_2\Analysis\PostProcess)",
                         filters=matrix(data=c("refmap_listest1_2_testdataMerge_BySubj.csv", "refmap_listest1_2_testdataMerge_BySubj.csv"), ncol=2))

subjData <- read.csv(subjDataPath, header=TRUE)

stimDataPath <- utils::choose.files(caption=r"(Select refmap_listest1_2_testdataMerge_ByStim.csv from 03 Experiment\Experiment_1_2\Analysis\PostProcess)",
                                     filters=matrix(data=c("refmap_listest1_2_testdataMerge_ByStim.csv", "refmap_listest1_2_testdataMerge_ByStim.csv"), ncol=2))

stimData <- read.csv(stimDataPath, header=TRUE, row.names=1)

contrasts(stimData$Experiment) <- contr.sum(2)

UASTypeCats <- c("Baseline", "H520", "M300", "T150")

# encode factors

subjData$UASType <- factor(subjData$UASType, levels=UASTypeCats)
subjData$AmbientEnv <- factor(subjData$AmbientEnv, levels=c("Park", "Residential", "Park (high)",
                                                            "Highway (low)", "Streetside square", "Highway"))
subjData$AmbientEnvCore <- factor(subjData$AmbientEnvCore, levels=c("Park", "Residential",
                                                                    "Streetside square", "Highway"))
subjData$AAMAttitude <- factor(subjData$AAMAttitude)
subjData$HomeArea <- factor(subjData$HomeArea)
subjData$SoundscapeArea <- factor(subjData$SoundscapeArea)
subjData$NationGeo <- factor(subjData$NationGeo)
subjData$UKNational <- factor(subjData$UKNational)
subjData$Sex <- factor(subjData$Sex, levels=c("Female", "Male"))

stimData$UASOperation <- factor(stimData$UASOperation, levels=UASOpCats)
stimData$UASType <- factor(stimData$UASType, levels=UASTypeCats)
stimData$AmbientEnv <- factor(stimData$AmbientEnv, levels=c("Park", "Residential", "Park (high)",
                                                            "Highway (low)", "Streetside square", "Highway"))
stimData$AmbientEnvCore <- factor(stimData$AmbientEnvCore, levels=c("Park", "Residential",
                                                                    "Streetside square", "Highway"))

# For Age column in subjData, replace "No answer" with NA, and then convert to numeric using dplyr and pipe
subjData <- subjData |> dplyr::mutate(Age = case_when(Age == "No answer" ~ NA_character_, TRUE ~ Age)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Age = as.numeric(Age))

# recode AAM_attitude to 2 groups
subjData <- subjData |> dplyr::mutate(AAM_attitude2 = dplyr::recode_values(AAMAttitude,
                                                                    "Supportive" ~ "Supportive",
                                                                    c("Ambivalent",
                                                                      "Concerned",
                                                                      "Neutral") ~ "Ambiv_Concern_Neutral"))
subjData$AAM_attitude2 <- factor(subjData$AAM_attitude2, levels=c("Supportive", "Ambiv_Concern_Neutral"))

# recode NationGeo to 3 groups
subjData <- subjData |> dplyr::mutate(NationGeo3 = dplyr::recode_values(NationGeo,
                                                                 "UK" ~ "UK",
                                                                 c("Africa",
                                                                   "SouthAsia") ~ "Africa_SAsia",
                                                                 c("EastAsia",
                                                                   "Australasia",
                                                                   "Europe",
                                                                   "MidEast",
                                                                   "SouthAmerica",
                                                                   "NotAnswered",
                                                                   NA, "") ~ "Other"))
subjData$NationGeo3 <- factor(subjData$NationGeo3)

# recode NationGeo to 2 groups
subjData <- subjData |> dplyr::mutate(NationGeo2 = dplyr::recode_values(NationGeo,
                                                                 "UK" ~ "UK",
                                                                 c("Africa",
                                                                   "SouthAsia",
                                                                   "Australasia",
                                                                   "EastAsia",
                                                                   "Europe",
                                                                   "MidEast",
                                                                   "SouthAmerica",
                                                                   "NotAnswered",
                                                                   NA, "") ~ "Other"))
subjData$NationGeo2 <- factor(subjData$NationGeo2)

# recode Area of residence to 2 groups
subjData <- subjData |> dplyr::mutate(Home_Area2 = dplyr::recode_values(HomeArea,
                                                         "Urban" ~ "Urban",
                                                         c("Suburban",
                                                           "Rural") ~ "Suburban_Rural"))
subjData$Home_Area2 <- factor(subjData$Home_Area2)


# recode Area soundscape to 2 groups
subjData <- subjData |> dplyr::mutate(Area_soundscape2 = dplyr::recode_values(SoundscapeArea,
                                                                       c("Calm",
                                                                         "Vibrant") ~ "Pleasant",
                                                                       c("Chaotic",
                                                                         "Monotonous") ~ "Unpleasant"))

subjData$Area_soundscape2 <- factor(subjData$Area_soundscape2, levels=c("Unpleasant", "Pleasant"))

subjData <- subjData |> dplyr::mutate(UASDisc0p5PAEMaxLR = 2e-5*10^(UASDisc0p5LAEMaxLR/20))
subjData <- subjData |> dplyr::mutate(IntermitRatioC2MaxLRScl = IntermitRatioC2MaxLR/100)
subjData <- subjData |> dplyr::mutate(IntermitRatioC3MaxLRScl = IntermitRatioC3MaxLR/100)
subjData <- subjData |> dplyr::mutate(IntermitRatioC5MaxLRScl = IntermitRatioC5MaxLR/100)

stimData <- stimData |> dplyr::mutate(UASDisc0p5PAEMaxLR = 2e-5*10^(UASDisc0p5LAEMaxLR/20))
stimData <- stimData |> dplyr::mutate(IntermitRatioC2MaxLRScl = IntermitRatioC2MaxLR/100)
stimData <- stimData |> dplyr::mutate(IntermitRatioC3MaxLRScl = IntermitRatioC3MaxLR/100)
stimData <- stimData |> dplyr::mutate(IntermitRatioC5MaxLRScl = IntermitRatioC5MaxLR/100)

# Log other variables
subjData$PartLoudSHMPowAvgLog <- log(subjData$PartLoudSHMPowAvg)
stimData$PartLoudSHMPowAvgLog <- log(stimData$PartLoudSHMPowAvg)

# reorder by participant ID and trial number
subjData <- subjData[with(subjData, order(Experiment, PersonNum, TrialNumber)), ]

# add a rescaled dAnnoyance variable
subjData <- subjData |>
  dplyr::mutate(AnnoyanceOrdBetaScl = betaTransform(Annoyance, 0, 10,
                                                    direction='forward', squeeze='none'),
                dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl = betaTransform(dAnnoyance, -10, 10,
                                                     direction='forward', squeeze='none'))

# add a rescaled dAnnoyance variable
stimData <- stimData |>
  dplyr::mutate(AnnoyMeanOrdBetaScl = betaTransform(AnnoyanceMean, 0, 10,
                                                    direction='forward', squeeze='none'),
                dAnnoyMeanOrdBetaScl = betaTransform(dAnnoyanceMean, -10, 10,
                                                     direction='forward', squeeze='none'),
                AnnoyMedianOrdBetaScl = betaTransform(AnnoyanceMedian, 0, 10,
                                                    direction='forward', squeeze='none'),
                dAnnoyMedianOrdBetaScl = betaTransform(dAnnoyanceMedian, 0, 10,  # note: intentional rescaling to [0, 10]
                                                     direction='forward', squeeze='none'))

# omit ambient-only stimuli
subjDataNoAmb <- subjData |> dplyr::filter(UASType != "Baseline") |>
  droplevels() |>
  arrange(Experiment, PersonNum, TrialNumber)

stimDataNoAmb <- stimData |> dplyr::filter(UASType != "Baseline") |>
  droplevels() |>
  arrange(Experiment, StimNum)

subjDataNoAmb$Experiment <- factor(subjDataNoAmb$Experiment)
contrasts(subjDataNoAmb$Experiment) <- contr.sum(2)

stimDataNoAmb$Experiment <- factor(stimDataNoAmb$Experiment)
contrasts(stimDataNoAmb$Experiment) <- contr.sum(2)

```

## filter and impute missing age data (median imputation)

```{R}

# first create a participant-level dataset
subj1_dat <- subset(subjData, Experiment == 1) |> dplyr::select(ParticipantNum,
                                                                      Age) |> dplyr::distinct()

# create a median imputation for missing age data
subj1_dat.med <- subj1_dat |> dplyr::mutate(Age = ifelse(is.na(Age),
                                                   median(Age, na.rm=TRUE),
                                                   Age))

# now merge the imputed age data back into the main dataset
subjData.med <- subjData |> dplyr::select(-Age) |> dplyr::left_join(subj1_dat.med, by="ParticipantNum")

# now filter the dataset to exclude ambient-only stimuli
subjDataNoAmb.med <- subjData.med |> dplyr::filter(UASType != "Baseline") |>
  droplevels()

```

# dAnnoyMedian:

```{r}

transform_dAnnoyMd <- \(x) betaTransform(x, 0, 10, direction = 'reverse',
                                         squeeze = 'none')

r2_1 <- \(x, y) 1 - sum((x - y)^2)/sum((x - mean(x))^2)

```

## S1: LAE and UAS events

### formula

```{r}

m_dA1a_f <- dAnnoyMedianOrdBetaScl ~ UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.105917955) +
  Experiment

m_dA1a_d <- stimDataNoAmb[, c(StimNum='StimNum',
                             all.vars(m_dA1a_f)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(dAnnoyMedianOrdBetaScl))

m_dA1b_f <- dAnnoyMedianOrdBetaScl ~ UASLAEMaxLR + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.105917955) +
  Experiment

m_dA1b_d <- stimDataNoAmb[, c(StimNum='StimNum',
                             all.vars(m_dA1b_f)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(dAnnoyMedianOrdBetaScl))

```

### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}


m_dA1a <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(formula=m_dA1a_f, dispformula= ~ Experiment,
                          data=m_dA1a_d,
                          family=glmmTMB::ordbeta(link='logit'),
                          control=glmmTMBctrl)

m_dA1b <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(formula=m_dA1b_f, dispformula= ~ Experiment,
                          data=m_dA1b_d,
                          family=glmmTMB::ordbeta(link='logit'),
                          control=glmmTMBctrl)

parameters::model_parameters(m_dA1a, dispersion=TRUE)
parameters::model_parameters(m_dA1b, dispersion=TRUE)

performance::compare_performance(m_dA1a, m_dA1b)

```

### compare CV performance

```{r}

cv_m_dA1a <- cv_mean_model(m_dA1a, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps,
                           strata = 'Experiment', group = 'StimNum',
                           inverse = function(p) 10 * p, seed = 1, parallel = TRUE)

cv_m_dA1b <- cv_mean_model(m_dA1b, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps,
                           strata = 'Experiment', group = 'StimNum',
                           inverse = function(p) 10 * p, seed = 1, parallel = TRUE)

compare_mean_models(m_dA1a=cv_m_dA1a, m_dA1b=cv_m_dA1b)

```

### generate deployment version

```{r}

m_dA1b_deploy <- deploy_mean_model(m_dA1b,
                                   scaling_data = stimDataNoAmb,
                                   Experiment=0, coef_simplify=T, verbose=TRUE)

```

### analyse deployment performance

```{r}

m_dA1b_boot <- boot_mean_model(deployed=m_dA1b_deploy, trial_data=subjDataNoAmb.med,
                               cluster='PersonNum', response='dAnnoyance',
                               stat = 'median', by = 'StimNum',
                               strata = 'Experiment', resample = 'clusters',
                               stimulus_strata = 'Experiment',
                               response_transform = function(x) pmax(x, 0)/10,
                               jitter_step=1, interval = 'bc',
                               jitter_rows = subjDataNoAmb.med[['Experiment']] == 1,
                               recentre='mean', regrid=0.5, newdata = NULL,
                               B = 2000, level = 0.95,
                               prediction_intervals = FALSE, pi_draws = 10L,
                               parallel = TRUE, seed = 999, verbose = TRUE)

cv_m_dA1b <- cv_mean_model(m_dA1b_deploy, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps, strata = 'Experiment',
                           group = 'StimNum',
                     inverse = function(p) 10 * p, seed = 1, parallel = TRUE)

UASLAE_swp <- seq(min(stimDataNoAmb[['UASLAEMaxLR']]),
                           max(stimDataNoAmb[['UASLAEMaxLR']]),
                           length.out=20)

grid_pred <- insight::get_datagrid(x=subset(m_dA1b_d,
  select=-c(StimNum, dAnnoyMedianOrdBetaScl)),
  by=list(UASLAEMaxLR=UASLAE_swp,
          Experiment=0, UASEvents=c(1, 2, 3, 5, 9)))

m_dA1b_bt_pred <- predict(m_dA1b_boot, newdata = grid_pred,
                          model=m_dA1b_deploy, target = 'deployed')

m_dA1b_predict <- transform_dAnnoyMd(predict.glmmTMB.ordbeta(m_dA1b, newdata=stimDataNoAmb, type='response'))

m_dA1b_dep_predict <- transform_dAnnoyMd(m_dA1b_deploy(stimDataNoAmb))

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMedian - m_dA1b_dep_predict)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMedian - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMedian))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m_dA1b_dep_predict,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyanceMedian', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyanceMedianCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyanceMedianCI_High', fitted='estimate')

R2_cv <- subset(cv_m_dA1b[['summary']], target=="deployed" & metric == "R2")['cv_mean']
RMSE_CV <- subset(cv_m_dA1b[['summary']], target=="deployed" & metric == "RMSE")['cv_mean']

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=merge(m_dA1b_boot[['predictions']][, c('StimNum', 'estimate', 'lower', 'upper')],
                  data.frame(Experiment = stimDataNoAmb[['Experiment']],
                             StimNum = stimDataNoAmb[['StimNum']],
                             response = stimDataNoAmb[['dAnnoyanceMedian']],
                             responseCI_Low = stimDataNoAmb[['dAnnoyanceMedianCI_Low']],
                             responseCI_High = stimDataNoAmb[['dAnnoyanceMedianCI_High']]),
                  by = "StimNum")) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, colour=Experiment, shape=Experiment), size=1.75, stroke=0.75, alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate, colour=Experiment), width=0, alpha=0.1) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=lower, ymax=upper, colour=Experiment), width=0, alpha=0.1) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(values=mycolours[1:2], name="Experiment", guide=guide_legend(ncol = 2, position = 'top')) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(4, 0), name="Experiment", guide=guide_legend(ncol = 2, position = 'top')) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1)) +
  
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(-1.5, 9.5), ylim=c(-0.5, 10.5), expand=FALSE) +
  
  labs(x="Median change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted median annoyance increase") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=-0.5, y=10, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
```

## S2: UAS SQMs and events, no ambient info

### formula

```{r}

m_dA2a_f <- dAnnoyMedianOrdBetaScl ~ UASLAEMaxLR + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.105917955) +
  UASSharpAurISO305Ex + Experiment

m_dA2a_d <- stimDataNoAmb[, c(StimNum='StimNum',
                             all.vars(m_dA2a_f)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(dAnnoyMedianOrdBetaScl))

m_dA2b_f <- dAnnoyMedianOrdBetaScl ~ UASLAEMaxLR + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.105917955) +
  UASTonalAwSHMInt05Ex + UASSharpAurISO305Ex + Experiment

m_dA2b_d <- stimDataNoAmb[, c(StimNum='StimNum',
                             all.vars(m_dA2b_f)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(dAnnoyMedianOrdBetaScl))

m_dA2c_f <- dAnnoyMedianOrdBetaScl ~ UASLAEMaxLR + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.105917955) +
  UASTonalAwSHMInt05Ex + UASSharpAurISO305Ex + UASImpulsSHMAvg + Experiment

m_dA2c_d <- stimDataNoAmb[, c(StimNum='StimNum',
                             all.vars(m_dA2c_f)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(dAnnoyMedianOrdBetaScl))

m_dA2d_f <- dAnnoyMedianOrdBetaScl ~ UASLAEMaxLR + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.105917955) +
  UASTonalAwSHMInt05Ex + UASSharpAurISO305Ex + UASImpulsSHMAvg + UASRoughECMA10Ex +
  Experiment

m_dA2d_d <- stimDataNoAmb[, c(StimNum='StimNum',
                             all.vars(m_dA2d_f)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(dAnnoyMedianOrdBetaScl))

m_dA2e_f <- dAnnoyMedianOrdBetaScl ~ UASLoudECMAPowAvg + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.105917955) +
  UASSharpAurISO305Ex + Experiment

m_dA2e_d <- stimDataNoAmb[, c(StimNum='StimNum',
                             all.vars(m_dA2e_f)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(dAnnoyMedianOrdBetaScl))

m_dA2f_f <- dAnnoyMedianOrdBetaScl ~ UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.105917955) +
  UASSharpAurISO305Ex + Experiment

m_dA2f_d <- stimDataNoAmb[, c(StimNum='StimNum',

  dplyr::filter(!is.na(dAnnoyMedianOrdBetaScl))


```

### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}


m_dA2a <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(formula=m_dA2a_f, dispformula= ~ Experiment,
                          data=m_dA2a_d,
                          family=glmmTMB::ordbeta(link='logit'),
                          control=glmmTMBctrl)

m_dA2b <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(formula=m_dA2b_f, dispformula= ~ Experiment,
                          data=m_dA2b_d,
                          family=glmmTMB::ordbeta(link='logit'),
                          control=glmmTMBctrl)

m_dA2c <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(formula=m_dA2c_f, dispformula= ~ Experiment,
                          data=m_dA2c_d,
                          family=glmmTMB::ordbeta(link='logit'),
                          control=glmmTMBctrl)

m_dA2d <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(formula=m_dA2d_f, dispformula= ~ Experiment,
                          data=m_dA2d_d,
                          family=glmmTMB::ordbeta(link='logit'),
                          control=glmmTMBctrl)

m_dA2e <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(formula=m_dA2e_f, dispformula= ~ Experiment,
                          data=m_dA2e_d,
                          family=glmmTMB::ordbeta(link='logit'),
                          control=glmmTMBctrl)


m_dA2f <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(formula=m_dA2f_f, dispformula= ~ Experiment,
                          data=m_dA2f_d,
                          family=glmmTMB::ordbeta(link='logit'),
                          control=glmmTMBctrl)

parameters::model_parameters(m_dA2a, dispersion=TRUE)
parameters::model_parameters(m_dA2b, dispersion=TRUE)
parameters::model_parameters(m_dA2c, dispersion=TRUE)
parameters::model_parameters(m_dA2d, dispersion=TRUE)
parameters::model_parameters(m_dA2e, dispersion=TRUE)
parameters::model_parameters(m_dA2f, dispersion=TRUE)

performance::compare_performance(m_dA1b, m_dA2a, m_dA2b, m_dA2c, m_dA2d, m_dA2e,
```

```{r}
cv_m_dA2a <- cv_mean_model(m_dA2a, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps,

cv_m_dA2d <- cv_mean_model(m_dA2d, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps,

                           inverse = function(p) 10 * p, seed = 1, parallel = TRUE)

cv_m_dA2e <- cv_mean_model(m_dA2e, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps,

                           inverse = function(p) 10 * p, seed = 1, parallel = TRUE)

cv_m_dA2f <- cv_mean_model(m_dA2f, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps,
```

### generate deployment version

```{r}

m_dA2a_deploy <- deploy_mean_model(m_dA2a,
                                   scaling_data = stimDataNoAmb,
                                   Experiment=0, coef_simplify=T, verbose=TRUE)

```

### analyse deployment performance

```{r}

m_dA2a_boot <- boot_mean_model(deployed=m_dA2a_deploy, trial_data=subjDataNoAmb.med,
                               cluster='PersonNum', response='dAnnoyance',
                               stat = 'median', by = 'StimNum',
                               strata = 'Experiment', resample = 'clusters',
                               stimulus_strata = 'Experiment',
                               response_transform = function(x) pmax(x, 0)/10,
                               jitter_step=1, interval = 'bc',
                               jitter_rows = subjDataNoAmb.med[['Experiment']] == 1,
                               recentre='mean', regrid=0.5, newdata = NULL,
                               B = 2000, level = 0.95,
                               prediction_intervals = FALSE, pi_draws = 10L,
                               parallel = TRUE, seed = 999, verbose = TRUE)

cv_m_dA2a <- cv_mean_model(m_dA2a_deploy, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps,
                           strata = 'Experiment', group = 'StimNum',
                           inverse = function(p) 10 * p, seed = 1, parallel = TRUE)

m_dA2a_predict <- transform_dAnnoyMd(predict.glmmTMB.ordbeta(m_dA2a, newdata=stimDataNoAmb, type='response'))

m_dA2a_dep_predict <- transform_dAnnoyMd(m_dA2a_deploy(stimDataNoAmb))

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMedian - m_dA2a_dep_predict)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMedian - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMedian))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m_dA2a_dep_predict,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyanceMedian', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyanceMedianCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyanceMedianCI_High', fitted='estimate')

R2_cv <- subset(cv_m_dA2a[['summary']], target=="deployed" & metric == "R2")['cv_mean']
RMSE_CV <- subset(cv_m_dA2a[['summary']], target=="deployed" & metric == "RMSE")['cv_mean']

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=merge(m_dA2a_boot[['predictions']][, c('StimNum', 'estimate', 'lower', 'upper')],
                  data.frame(Experiment = stimDataNoAmb[['Experiment']],
                             StimNum = stimDataNoAmb[['StimNum']],
                             response = stimDataNoAmb[['dAnnoyanceMedian']],
                             responseCI_Low = stimDataNoAmb[['dAnnoyanceMedianCI_Low']],
                             responseCI_High = stimDataNoAmb[['dAnnoyanceMedianCI_High']]),
                  by = "StimNum")) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, colour=Experiment, shape=Experiment), size=1.75, stroke=0.75, alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate, colour=Experiment), width=0, alpha=0.1) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=lower, ymax=upper, colour=Experiment), width=0, alpha=0.1) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(values=mycolours[1:2], name="Experiment", guide=guide_legend(ncol = 2, position = 'top')) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(4, 0), name="Experiment", guide=guide_legend(ncol = 2, position = 'top')) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1)) +
  
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(-1.5, 9.5), ylim=c(-0.5, 10.5), expand=FALSE) +
  
  labs(x="Median change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted median annoyance increase") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=-0.5, y=10, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=-0.5, y=9.25, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)[CV]^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2_cv, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=-0.5, y=8.5, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = -0.5, y = 7.75, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE) +
ggplot2::annotate("text", x = -0.5, y = 7, label = paste0("RMSE[CV] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(RMSE_CV, 3))),
```

```{r}
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = -0.5, y = 7.75, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE) +
ggplot2::annotate("text", x = -0.5, y = 7, label = paste0("RMSE[CV] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(RMSE_CV, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)
```

### analyse deployment performance

```{r}

m_dA4d_boot <- boot_mean_model(deployed=m_dA4d_deploy, trial_data=subjDataNoAmb.med,
                               cluster='PersonNum', response='dAnnoyance',
                               stat = 'median', by = 'StimNum',
                               strata = 'Experiment', resample = 'clusters',
                               stimulus_strata = 'Experiment',
                               response_transform = function(x) pmax(x, 0)/10,
                               jitter_step=1, interval = 'bc',
                               jitter_rows = subjDataNoAmb.med[['Experiment']] == 1,
                               recentre='mean', regrid=0.5, newdata = NULL,
                               B = 2000, level = 0.95,
                               prediction_intervals = FALSE, pi_draws = 10L,
                               parallel = TRUE, seed = 999, verbose = TRUE)

cv_m_dA4d <- cv_mean_model(m_dA4d_deploy, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps,
                           strata = 'Experiment', group = 'StimNum',
                           inverse = function(p) 10 * p, seed = 1, parallel = TRUE)

m_dA4d_predict <- transform_dAnnoyMd(predict.glmmTMB.ordbeta(m_dA4d, newdata=stimDataNoAmb, type='response'))

m_dA4d_dep_predict <- transform_dAnnoyMd(m_dA4d_deploy(stimDataNoAmb))

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMedian - m_dA4d_dep_predict)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMedian - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMedian))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m_dA4d_dep_predict,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyanceMedian', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyanceMedianCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyanceMedianCI_High', fitted='estimate')

R2_cv <- subset(cv_m_dA4d[['summary']], target=="deployed" & metric == "R2")['cv_mean']
RMSE_CV <- subset(cv_m_dA4d[['summary']], target=="deployed" & metric == "RMSE")['cv_mean']

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=merge(m_dA4d_boot[['predictions']][, c('StimNum', 'estimate', 'lower', 'upper')],
                  data.frame(Experiment = stimDataNoAmb[['Experiment']],
                             StimNum = stimDataNoAmb[['StimNum']],
                             response = stimDataNoAmb[['dAnnoyanceMedian']],
                             responseCI_Low = stimDataNoAmb[['dAnnoyanceMedianCI_Low']],
                             responseCI_High = stimDataNoAmb[['dAnnoyanceMedianCI_High']]),
                  by = "StimNum")) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, colour=Experiment, shape=Experiment), size=1.75, stroke=0.75, alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate, colour=Experiment), width=0, alpha=0.1) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=lower, ymax=upper, colour=Experiment), width=0, alpha=0.1) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(values=mycolours[1:2], name="Experiment", guide=guide_legend(ncol = 2, position = 'top')) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(4, 0), name="Experiment", guide=guide_legend(ncol = 2, position = 'top')) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1)) +
  
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(-1.5, 9.5), ylim=c(-0.5, 10.5), expand=FALSE) +
  
  labs(x="Median change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted median annoyance increase") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=-0.5, y=10, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=-0.5, y=9.25, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)[CV]^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2_cv, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=-0.5, y=8.5, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = -0.5, y = 7.75, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE) +
ggplot2::annotate("text", x = -0.5, y = 7, label = paste0("RMSE[CV] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(RMSE_CV, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

  filename <- "DataMeld_dAnnoyMdn_PredMod_LAEEnvSQCal_Ob"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4.5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4.5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

### generate deployment version

```{r}

m_dA6d_deploy <- deploy_mean_model(m_dA6d,
                                   scaling_data = stimDataNoAmb,
                                   Experiment=0, coef_simplify=T, verbose=TRUE)

```

### analyse deployment performance

```{r}

m_dA6d_boot <- boot_mean_model(deployed=m_dA6d_deploy, trial_data=subjDataNoAmb.med,
                               cluster='PersonNum', response='dAnnoyance',
                               stat = 'median', by = 'StimNum',
                               strata = 'Experiment', resample = 'clusters',
                               stimulus_strata = 'Experiment',
                               response_transform = function(x) pmax(x, 0)/10,
                               jitter_step=1, interval = 'bc',
                               jitter_rows = subjDataNoAmb.med[['Experiment']] == 1,
                               recentre='mean', regrid=0.5, newdata = NULL,
                               B = 2000, level = 0.95,
                               prediction_intervals = FALSE, pi_draws = 10L,
                               parallel = TRUE, seed = 999, verbose = TRUE)

cv_m_dA6d <- cv_mean_model(m_dA6d_deploy, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps,
                           strata = 'Experiment', group = 'StimNum',
                           inverse = function(p) 10 * p, seed = 1, parallel = TRUE)

LAELAF50diff_swp <- seq(min(stimDataNoAmb[['LAELAF50diff']]),
                           max(stimDataNoAmb[['LAELAF50diff']]),
                           length.out=20)

grid_pred <- insight::get_datagrid(x=subset(m_dA6d_d,
  select=-c(StimNum, dAnnoyMedianOrdBetaScl)),
  by=list(LAELAF50diff=LAELAF50diff_swp,
          UASTonalAwSHMInt05Ex=mean(stimDataNoAmb[['UASTonalAwSHMInt05Ex']]),
          UASSharpAurISO305Ex=mean(stimDataNoAmb[['UASSharpAurISO305Ex']]),
          UASImpulsSHMAvg=mean(stimDataNoAmb[['UASImpulsSHMAvg']]),
          UASRoughECMA10Ex=mean(stimDataNoAmb[['UASRoughECMA10Ex']]),
          Experiment=0, UASEvents=c(1, 2, 3, 5, 9)))

m_dA6d_bt_pred <- predict(m_dA6d_boot, newdata = grid_pred,
                          model=m_dA6d_deploy, target = 'deployed')

m_dA6d_predict <- transform_dAnnoyMd(predict.glmmTMB.ordbeta(m_dA6d,
                                                             newdata=stimDataNoAmb,
                                                             type='response'))

m_dA6d_dep_predict <- transform_dAnnoyMd(m_dA6d_deploy(stimDataNoAmb))

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMedian - m_dA6d_dep_predict)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMedian - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMedian))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m_dA6d_dep_predict,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyanceMedian', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyanceMedianCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyanceMedianCI_High', fitted='estimate')

R2_cv <- subset(cv_m_dA6d[['summary']], target=="deployed" & metric == "R2")['cv_mean']
RMSE_CV <- subset(cv_m_dA6d[['summary']], target=="deployed" & metric == "RMSE")['cv_mean']

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=merge(m_dA6d_boot[['predictions']][, c('StimNum', 'estimate', 'lower', 'upper')],
                  data.frame(Experiment = stimDataNoAmb[['Experiment']],
                             StimNum = stimDataNoAmb[['StimNum']],
                             response = stimDataNoAmb[['dAnnoyanceMedian']],
                             responseCI_Low = stimDataNoAmb[['dAnnoyanceMedianCI_Low']],
                             responseCI_High = stimDataNoAmb[['dAnnoyanceMedianCI_High']]),
                  by = "StimNum")) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, colour=Experiment, shape=Experiment), size=1.75, stroke=0.75, alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate, colour=Experiment), width=0, alpha=0.1) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=lower, ymax=upper, colour=Experiment), width=0, alpha=0.1) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(values=mycolours[1:2], name="Experiment", guide=guide_legend(ncol = 2, position = 'top')) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(4, 0), name="Experiment", guide=guide_legend(ncol = 2, position = 'top')) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1)) +
  
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(-1.5, 9.5), ylim=c(-0.5, 10.5), expand=FALSE) +
  
  labs(x="Median change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted median annoyance increase") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=-0.5, y=10, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=-0.5, y=9.25, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)[CV]^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2_cv, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=-0.5, y=8.5, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = -0.5, y = 7.75, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE) +
ggplot2::annotate("text", x = -0.5, y = 7, label = paste0("RMSE[CV] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(RMSE_CV, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)
```

```{r}
                          family=glmmTMB::ordbeta(link='logit'),
                          control=glmmTMBctrl)

m_dA7e <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(formula=m_dA7e_f, dispformula= ~ Experiment,
                          data=m_dA7e_d,
                          family=glmmTMB::ordbeta(link='logit'),
                          control=glmmTMBctrl)

parameters::model_parameters(m_dA7a, dispersion=TRUE)
parameters::model_parameters(m_dA7b, dispersion=TRUE)
parameters::model_parameters(m_dA7c, dispersion=TRUE)
parameters::model_parameters(m_dA7d, dispersion=TRUE)
parameters::model_parameters(m_dA7e, dispersion=TRUE)

performance::compare_performance(m_dA1b, m_dA2a, m_dA3a, m_dA4d, m_dA5b, m_dA6d,
```

```{r}
cv_m_dA7a <- cv_mean_model(m_dA7a, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps,
                           strata = 'Experiment', group = 'StimNum',

cv_m_dA7b <- cv_mean_model(m_dA7b, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps,
```

### generate deployment version

```{r}

m_dA7b_deploy <- deploy_mean_model(m_dA7b,
                                   scaling_data = stimDataNoAmb,
                                   Experiment=0, coef_simplify=T, verbose=TRUE)

```

### analyse deployment performance

```{r}

m_dA7b_boot <- boot_mean_model(deployed=m_dA7b_deploy, trial_data=subjDataNoAmb.med,
                               cluster='PersonNum', response='dAnnoyance',
                               stat = 'median', by = 'StimNum',
                               strata = 'Experiment', resample = 'clusters',
                               stimulus_strata = 'Experiment',
                               response_transform = function(x) pmax(x, 0)/10,
                               jitter_step=1, interval = 'bc',
                               jitter_rows = subjDataNoAmb.med[['Experiment']] == 1,
                               recentre='mean', regrid=0.5, newdata = NULL,
                               B = 2000, level = 0.95,
                               prediction_intervals = FALSE, pi_draws = 10L,
                               parallel = TRUE, seed = 999, verbose = TRUE)

cv_m_dA7b <- cv_mean_model(m_dA7b_deploy, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps, strata = 'Experiment', group = 'StimNum',
                     inverse = function(p) 10 * p, seed = 1, parallel = TRUE)

Detect0p5dBIntEx50_swp <- seq(min(stimDataNoAmb[['Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLR']]),
                           max(stimDataNoAmb[['Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLR']]),
                           length.out=20)

grid_pred <- insight::get_datagrid(x=subset(m_dA7b_d,
  select=-c(StimNum, dAnnoyMedianOrdBetaScl)),
  by=list(Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLR=Detect0p5dBIntEx50_swp,
          Experiment=0, UASEvents=c(1, 2, 3, 5, 9)))

m_dA7b_bt_pred <- predict(m_dA7b_boot, newdata = grid_pred,
                          model=m_dA7b_deploy, target = 'deployed')

m_dA7b_predict <- transform_dAnnoyMd(predict.glmmTMB.ordbeta(m_dA7b,
                                                             newdata=stimDataNoAmb,
                                                             type='response'))

m_dA7b_cv <- cv::cv(m_dA7b, criterion=r2_1, k=10, seed=999)

m_dA7b_dep_predict <- transform_dAnnoyMd(m_dA7b_deploy(stimDataNoAmb))

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMedian - m_dA7b_dep_predict)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMedian - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMedian))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m_dA7b_dep_predict,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyanceMedian', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyanceMedianCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyanceMedianCI_High', fitted='estimate')

R2_cv <- subset(cv_m_dA7b[['summary']], target=="deployed" & metric == "R2")['cv_mean']
RMSE_CV <- subset(cv_m_dA7b[['summary']], target=="deployed" & metric == "RMSE")['cv_mean']

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=merge(m_dA7b_boot[['predictions']][, c('StimNum', 'estimate', 'lower', 'upper')],
                  data.frame(Experiment = stimDataNoAmb[['Experiment']],
                             StimNum = stimDataNoAmb[['StimNum']],
                             response = stimDataNoAmb[['dAnnoyanceMedian']],
                             responseCI_Low = stimDataNoAmb[['dAnnoyanceMedianCI_Low']],
                             responseCI_High = stimDataNoAmb[['dAnnoyanceMedianCI_High']]),
                  by = "StimNum")) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, colour=Experiment, shape=Experiment), size=1.75, stroke=0.75, alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate, colour=Experiment), width=0, alpha=0.1) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=lower, ymax=upper, colour=Experiment), width=0, alpha=0.1) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(values=mycolours[1:2], name="Experiment", guide=guide_legend(ncol = 2, position = 'top')) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(4, 0), name="Experiment", guide=guide_legend(ncol = 2, position = 'top')) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1)) +
  
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(-1.5, 9.5), ylim=c(-0.5, 10.5), expand=FALSE) +
  
  labs(x="Median change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted median annoyance increase") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=-0.5, y=10, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=-0.5, y=9.25, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)[CV]^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2_cv, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=-0.5, y=8.5, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = -0.5, y = 7.75, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE) +
ggplot2::annotate("text", x = -0.5, y = 7, label = paste0("RMSE[CV] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(RMSE_CV, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)
```

### analyse deployment performance

```{r}

m_dA8k_boot <- boot_mean_model(deployed=m_dA8k_deploy, trial_data=subjDataNoAmb.med,
                               cluster='PersonNum', response='dAnnoyance',
                               stat = 'median', by = 'StimNum',
                               strata = 'Experiment', resample = 'clusters',
                               stimulus_strata = 'Experiment',
                               response_transform = function(x) pmax(x, 0)/10,
                               jitter_step=1, interval = 'bc',
                               jitter_rows = subjDataNoAmb.med[['Experiment']] == 1,
                               recentre='mean', regrid=0.5, newdata = NULL,
                               B = 2000, level = 0.95,
                               prediction_intervals = FALSE, pi_draws = 10L,
                               parallel = TRUE, seed = 999, verbose = TRUE)

cv_m_dA8k <- cv_mean_model(m_dA8k_deploy, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps, strata = 'Experiment', group = 'StimNum',
                     inverse = function(p) 10 * p, seed = 1, parallel = TRUE)

LAELAF50diff_swp <- seq(min(stimDataNoAmb[['LAELAF50diff']]),
                           max(stimDataNoAmb[['LAELAF50diff']]),
                           length.out=20)

grid_pred <- insight::get_datagrid(x=subset(m_dA8k_d,
  select=-c(StimNum, dAnnoyMedianOrdBetaScl)),
  by=list(LAELAF50diff=LAELAF50diff_swp,
          dTonalECMAAvg=mean(stimDataNoAmb[['dTonalECMAAvg']]),
          dSharpAurISO3PowAvg=quantile(stimDataNoAmb[['dSharpAurISO3PowAvg']], probs=c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), na.rm=TRUE),
          dImpulsSHM05Ex=mean(stimDataNoAmb[['dImpulsSHM05Ex']]),
          UASRoughECMA10Ex=mean(stimDataNoAmb[['UASRoughECMA10Ex']]),
          dFluctECMA10Ex=mean(stimDataNoAmb[['dFluctECMA10Ex']]),
          Experiment=0, UASEvents=c(1, 2, 3, 5, 9)))

m_dA8k_bt_pred <- predict(m_dA8k_boot, newdata = grid_pred,
                          model=m_dA8k_deploy, target = 'deployed')

m_dA8k_predict <- transform_dAnnoyMd(predict.glmmTMB.ordbeta(m_dA8k, newdata=stimDataNoAmb, type='response'))

m_dA8k_cv <- cv::cv(m_dA8k, criterion=r2_1, k=10, seed=999)

m_dA8k_dep_predict <- transform_dAnnoyMd(m_dA8k_deploy(stimDataNoAmb))

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMedian - m_dA8k_dep_predict)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMedian - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyanceMedian))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m_dA8k_dep_predict,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyanceMedian', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyanceMedianCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyanceMedianCI_High', fitted='estimate')

R2_cv <- subset(cv_m_dA8k[['summary']], target=="deployed" & metric == "R2")['cv_mean']
RMSE_CV <- subset(cv_m_dA8k[['summary']], target=="deployed" & metric == "RMSE")['cv_mean']

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=merge(m_dA8k_boot[['predictions']][, c('StimNum', 'estimate', 'lower', 'upper')],
                  data.frame(Experiment = stimDataNoAmb[['Experiment']],
                             StimNum = stimDataNoAmb[['StimNum']],
                             response = stimDataNoAmb[['dAnnoyanceMedian']],
                             responseCI_Low = stimDataNoAmb[['dAnnoyanceMedianCI_Low']],
                             responseCI_High = stimDataNoAmb[['dAnnoyanceMedianCI_High']]),
                  by = "StimNum")) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, colour=Experiment, shape=Experiment), size=1.75, stroke=0.75, alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate, colour=Experiment), width=0, alpha=0.1) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=lower, ymax=upper, colour=Experiment), width=0, alpha=0.1) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(values=mycolours[1:2], name="Experiment", guide=guide_legend(ncol = 2, position = 'top')) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(4, 0), name="Experiment", guide=guide_legend(ncol = 2, position = 'top')) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1)) +
  
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(-1.5, 9.5), ylim=c(-0.5, 10.5), expand=FALSE) +
  
  labs(x="Median change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted median annoyance increase") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=-0.5, y=10, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=-0.5, y=9.25, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)[CV]^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2_cv, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=-0.5, y=8.5, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = -0.5, y = 7.75, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE) +
ggplot2::annotate("text", x = -0.5, y = 7, label = paste0("RMSE[CV] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(RMSE_CV, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)
```

# dHigh Annoy

## S0: Benchmark for comparison

### formula

```{r}

m_dHA0a_f <- dHighlyAnnoyedProp ~ UASLAEMaxLR*I(log10(UASEvents)) + UASLAEMaxLR*AmbientEnvCore + 
  UASLAEMaxLR*UASOperation + UASLAEMaxLR*UASType + Experiment

m_dHA0a_d <- stimDataNoAmb[, c(StimID='StimNum',
                               all.vars(m_dHA0a_f)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(dHighlyAnnoyedProp))

m_dHA0b_f <- dHighlyAnnoyedProp ~ UASLAEMaxLR*I(log10(UASEvents)) + UASLAEMaxLR + AmbientEnvCore + UASOperation +
  UASType + Experiment

m_dHA0b_d <- stimDataNoAmb[, c(StimID='StimNum',
                               all.vars(m_dHA0b_f)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(dHighlyAnnoyedProp))

m_dHA0c_f <- dHighlyAnnoyedProp ~ UASLAEMaxLR*I(log10(UASEvents)) + UASLAEMaxLR + AmbientEnvCore +
  Experiment

m_dHA0c_d <- stimDataNoAmb[, c(StimID='StimNum',
                               all.vars(m_dHA0c_f)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(dHighlyAnnoyedProp))

```

### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m_dHA0a <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(formula=m_dHA0a_f, dispformula= ~ Experiment,
                          data=m_dHA0a_d,
                          family=glmmTMB::ordbeta(link='logit'),
                          control=glmmTMBctrl)

m_dHA0b <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(formula=m_dHA0b_f, dispformula= ~ Experiment,
                          data=m_dHA0b_d,
                          family=glmmTMB::ordbeta(link='logit'),
                          control=glmmTMBctrl)

m_dHA0c <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(formula=m_dHA0c_f, dispformula= ~ Experiment,
                          data=m_dHA0c_d,
                          family=glmmTMB::ordbeta(link='logit'),
                          control=glmmTMBctrl)

parameters::model_parameters(m_dHA0a, dispersion=TRUE)
parameters::model_parameters(m_dHA0b, dispersion=TRUE)
parameters::model_parameters(m_dHA0c, dispersion=TRUE)

performance::compare_performance(m_dHA0a, m_dHA0b, m_dHA0c)

```

```{r}
cv_m_dHA0b <- cv_mean_model(m_dHA0b, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps,
                           strata = 'Experiment', group = 'StimNum',
                           seed = 1, parallel = TRUE)

cv_m_dHA0c <- cv_mean_model(m_dHA0c, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps,

compare_mean_models(m_dHA0a=cv_m_dHA0a, m_dHA0b=cv_m_dHA0b, m_dHA0c=cv_m_dHA0c)
```

## S1: LAE and UAS events

### formula

```{r}

m_dHA1a_f <- dHighlyAnnoyedProp ~ UASLAEMaxLR + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.105917955) +
  Experiment

m_dHA1a_d <- stimDataNoAmb[, c(StimNum='StimNum',
                             all.vars(m_dHA1a_f)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(dHighlyAnnoyedProp))

m_dHA1b_f <- dHighlyAnnoyedProp ~ UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.105917955) +
  Experiment

m_dHA1b_d <- stimDataNoAmb[, c(StimNum='StimNum',
                             all.vars(m_dHA1b_f)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(dHighlyAnnoyedProp))

```

### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}


m_dHA1a <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(formula=m_dHA1a_f, dispformula= ~ Experiment,
                          data=m_dHA1a_d,
                          family=glmmTMB::ordbeta(link='logit'),
                          control=glmmTMBctrl)

m_dHA1b <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(formula=m_dHA1b_f, dispformula= ~ Experiment,
                          data=m_dHA1b_d,
                          family=glmmTMB::ordbeta(link='logit'),
                          control=glmmTMBctrl)

parameters::model_parameters(m_dHA1a, dispersion=TRUE)
parameters::model_parameters(m_dHA1b, dispersion=TRUE)

performance::compare_performance(m_dHA1a, m_dHA1b)

```

### compare CV performance

```{r}

cv_m_dHA1a <- cv_mean_model(m_dHA1a, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps,
                           strata = 'Experiment', group = 'StimNum',
                           seed = 1, parallel = TRUE)

cv_m_dHA1b <- cv_mean_model(m_dHA1b, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps,
                           strata = 'Experiment', group = 'StimNum',
                           seed = 1, parallel = TRUE)

compare_mean_models(m_dHA1a=cv_m_dHA1a, m_dHA1b=cv_m_dHA1b)

```

### generate deployment version

```{r}

m_dHA1a_deploy <- deploy_mean_model(m_dHA1a,
                                   scaling_data = stimDataNoAmb,
                                   Experiment=0, coef_simplify=T, verbose=TRUE)

```

### analyse deployment performance

```{r}

m_dHA1a_boot <- boot_mean_model(deployed=m_dHA1a_deploy,
                                trial_data=subjDataNoAmb.med,
                               cluster='PersonNum', response='dHighlyAnnoyed',
                               stat = 'mean', by = 'StimNum',
                               strata = 'Experiment', resample = 'clusters',
                               stimulus_strata = 'Experiment',
                               response_transform = NULL,
                               jitter_step=1, interval = 'bc',
                               jitter_rows = NULL,
                               recentre='mean', regrid=NULL, newdata = NULL,
                               B = 2000, level = 0.95,
                               prediction_intervals = FALSE, pi_draws = 10L,
                               parallel = TRUE, seed = 999, verbose = TRUE)

cv_m_dHA1a <- cv_mean_model(m_dHA1a_deploy, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps, strata = 'Experiment',
                           group = 'StimNum', seed = 1, parallel = TRUE)

UASLAE_swp <- seq(min(stimDataNoAmb[['UASLAEMaxLR']]),
                           max(stimDataNoAmb[['UASLAEMaxLR']]),
                           length.out=20)

grid_pred <- insight::get_datagrid(x=subset(m_dHA1a_d,
                                            select=-c(StimNum, dHighlyAnnoyedProp)),
  by=list(UASLAEMaxLR=UASLAE_swp,
          Experiment=0, UASEvents=c(1, 2, 3, 5, 9)))

m_dHA1a_bt_pred <- predict(m_dHA1a_boot, newdata = grid_pred,
                           model=m_dHA1a_deploy, target = 'deployed')

m_dHA1a_predict <- predict.glmmTMB.ordbeta(m_dHA1a, newdata=stimDataNoAmb, type='response')

m_dHA1a_dep_predict <- m_dHA1a_deploy(stimDataNoAmb)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp - m_dHA1a_dep_predict)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp -
                                                                                      mean(stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m_dHA1a_dep_predict,
                     measured_target='dHighlyAnnoyedProp', measured_ci_low='dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_High', fitted='estimate')

R2_cv <- subset(cv_m_dHA1a[['summary']], target=="deployed" & metric == "R2")['cv_mean']
RMSE_CV <- subset(cv_m_dHA1a[['summary']], target=="deployed" & metric == "RMSE")['cv_mean']

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=merge(m_dHA1a_boot[['predictions']][, c('StimNum', 'estimate', 'lower', 'upper')],
                  data.frame(Experiment = stimDataNoAmb[['Experiment']],
                             StimNum = stimDataNoAmb[['StimNum']],
                             response = stimDataNoAmb[['dHighlyAnnoyedProp']],
                             responseCI_Low = stimDataNoAmb[['dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_Low']],
                             responseCI_High = stimDataNoAmb[['dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_High']]),
                  by = "StimNum")) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, colour=Experiment, shape=Experiment), size=1.75, stroke=0.75, alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate, colour=Experiment), width=0, alpha=0.1) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=lower, ymax=upper, colour=Experiment), width=0, alpha=0.1) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(values=mycolours[1:2], name="Experiment", guide=guide_legend(ncol = 2, position = 'top')) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(4, 0), name="Experiment", guide=guide_legend(ncol = 2, position = 'top')) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10)) +
  
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(-0.05, 1.05), ylim=c(-0.05, 1.05), expand=FALSE) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")),
       y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.05, y=1, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.05, y=0.925, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)[CV]^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2_cv, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.05, y=0.85, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.05, y = 0.775, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE) +
ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.05, y = 0.7, label = paste0("RMSE[CV] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(RMSE_CV, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)
```

### generate deployment version

```{r}

m_dHA2d_deploy <- deploy_mean_model(m_dHA2d,
                                   scaling_data = stimDataNoAmb,
                                   Experiment=0, coef_simplify=T, verbose=TRUE)

```

### analyse deployment performance

```{r}

m_dHA2d_boot <- boot_mean_model(deployed=m_dHA2d_deploy,
  trial_data=subjDataNoAmb.med,
  cluster='PersonNum', response='dHighlyAnnoyed',
  stat = 'mean', by = 'StimNum',
  strata = 'Experiment', resample = 'clusters',
  stimulus_strata = 'Experiment',
  response_transform = NULL,
  jitter_step=1, interval = 'bc',
  jitter_rows = NULL,
  recentre='mean', regrid=NULL, newdata = NULL,
  B = 2000, level = 0.95,
  prediction_intervals = FALSE, pi_draws = 10L,
  parallel = TRUE, seed = 999, verbose = TRUE)

cv_m_dHA2d <- cv_mean_model(m_dHA2d_deploy, k = k_fold,
                            reps = cv_reps, strata = 'Experiment',
                           group = 'StimNum', seed = 1, parallel = TRUE)

UASLoudECMAPowAvg_swp <- seq(min(stimDataNoAmb[['UASLoudECMAPowAvg']]),
                           max(stimDataNoAmb[['UASLoudECMAPowAvg']]),
                           length.out=20)

grid_pred <- insight::get_datagrid(x=subset(m_dHA2d_d,
                                            select=-c(StimNum, dHighlyAnnoyedProp)),
  by=list(UASLoudECMAPowAvg=UASLoudECMAPowAvg_swp,
          Experiment=0, UASEvents=c(1, 2, 3, 5, 9)))

m_dHA2d_bt_pred <- predict(m_dHA2d_boot, newdata = grid_pred,
                           model=m_dHA2d_deploy, target = 'deployed')

m_dHA2d_predict <- predict.glmmTMB.ordbeta(m_dHA2d, newdata=stimDataNoAmb, type='response')

m_dHA2d_dep_predict <- m_dHA2d_deploy(stimDataNoAmb)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp - m_dHA2d_dep_predict)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp -
                                                                                      mean(stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m_dHA2d_dep_predict,
                     measured_target='dHighlyAnnoyedProp', measured_ci_low='dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_High', fitted='estimate')

R2_cv <- subset(cv_m_dHA2d[['summary']], target=="deployed" & metric == "R2")['cv_mean']
RMSE_CV <- subset(cv_m_dHA2d[['summary']], target=="deployed" & metric == "RMSE")['cv_mean']

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=merge(m_dHA2d_boot[['predictions']][, c('StimNum', 'estimate', 'lower', 'upper')],
                  data.frame(Experiment = stimDataNoAmb[['Experiment']],
                             StimNum = stimDataNoAmb[['StimNum']],
                             response = stimDataNoAmb[['dHighlyAnnoyedProp']],
                             responseCI_Low = stimDataNoAmb[['dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_Low']],
                             responseCI_High = stimDataNoAmb[['dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_High']]),
                  by = "StimNum")) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, colour=Experiment, shape=Experiment), size=1.75, stroke=0.75, alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate, colour=Experiment), width=0, alpha=0.1) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=lower, ymax=upper, colour=Experiment), width=0, alpha=0.1) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(values=mycolours[1:2], name="Experiment", guide=guide_legend(ncol = 2, position = 'top')) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(4, 0), name="Experiment", guide=guide_legend(ncol = 2, position = 'top')) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10)) +
  
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(-0.05, 1.05), ylim=c(-0.05, 1.05), expand=FALSE) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")), y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.05, y=1, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.05, y=0.925, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)[CV]^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2_cv, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.05, y=0.85, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.05, y = 0.775, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE) +
ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.05, y = 0.7, label = paste0("RMSE[CV] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(RMSE_CV, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)


if (saveplots){
  
  filename <- "DataMeld_dHighAnnoy_PredMod_NSQCal_Ob"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4.5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4.5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

## S3: UAS LAE and events, with ambient env

### formula

```{r}

m_dHA3a_f <- dHighlyAnnoyedProp ~ UASLAEMaxLR + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.105917955) +
  AmbientEnvCore + Experiment

m_dHA3a_d <- stimDataNoAmb[, c(StimNum='StimNum',
                             all.vars(m_dHA3a_f)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(dHighlyAnnoyedProp))

m_dHA3b_f <- dHighlyAnnoyedProp ~ UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.105917955) +
  AmbientEnvCore + Experiment

m_dHA3b_d <- stimDataNoAmb[, c(StimNum='StimNum',
                             all.vars(m_dHA3b_f)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(dHighlyAnnoyedProp))


```

### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m_dHA3a <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(formula=m_dHA3a_f, dispformula= ~ Experiment,
                          data=m_dHA3a_d,
                          family=glmmTMB::ordbeta(link='logit'),
                          control=glmmTMBctrl)

m_dHA3b <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(formula=m_dHA3b_f, dispformula= ~ Experiment,
                          data=m_dHA3b_d,
                          family=glmmTMB::ordbeta(link='logit'),
                          control=glmmTMBctrl)

parameters::model_parameters(m_dHA3a, dispersion=TRUE)
parameters::model_parameters(m_dHA3b, dispersion=TRUE)

performance::compare_performance(m_dHA1a, m_dHA2d, m_dHA3a, m_dHA3b)

```

### compare CV performance

```{r}

cv_m_dHA3a <- cv_mean_model(m_dHA3a, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps,

cv_m_dHA3b <- cv_mean_model(m_dHA3b, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps,

compare_mean_models(m_dHA3a=cv_m_dHA3a, m_dHA3b=cv_m_dHA3b)
```

## S4: UAS SQ and events, with ambient env

### formula

```{r}

m_dHA4a_f <- dHighlyAnnoyedProp ~ UASLoudISO3PowAvg + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.105917955) +
  AmbientEnvCore + Experiment

  dplyr::filter(!is.na(dHighlyAnnoyedProp))
```

### generate deployment version

```{r}

m_dHA4d_deploy <- deploy_mean_model(m_dHA4d,
                                   scaling_data = stimDataNoAmb,
                                   Experiment=0, coef_simplify=T, verbose=TRUE)

```

### analyse deployment performance

```{r}

m_dHA4d_boot <- boot_mean_model(deployed=m_dHA4d_deploy,
  trial_data=subjDataNoAmb.med,
  cluster='PersonNum', response='dHighlyAnnoyed',
  stat = 'mean', by = 'StimNum',
  strata = 'Experiment', resample = 'clusters',
  stimulus_strata = 'Experiment',
  response_transform = NULL,
  jitter_step=1, interval = 'bc',
  jitter_rows = NULL,
  recentre='mean', regrid=NULL, newdata = NULL,
  B = 2000, level = 0.95,
  prediction_intervals = FALSE, pi_draws = 10L,
  parallel = TRUE, seed = 999, verbose = TRUE)

cv_m_dHA4d <- cv_mean_model(m_dHA4d_deploy, k = k_fold,
                            reps = cv_reps, strata = 'Experiment',
                           group = 'StimNum', seed = 1, parallel = TRUE)

UASLoudECMAPowAvg_swp <- seq(min(stimDataNoAmb[['UASLoudECMAPowAvg']]),
                           max(stimDataNoAmb[['UASLoudECMAPowAvg']]),
                           length.out=20)

grid_pred_1 <- insight::get_datagrid(x=subset(m_dHA4d_d,
                                            select=-c(StimNum, dHighlyAnnoyedProp)),
  by=list(UASLoudECMAPowAvg=UASLoudECMAPowAvg_swp,
          AmbientEnvCore=levels(stimDataNoAmb[['AmbientEnvCore']]),
          Experiment=0, UASEvents=c(1, 2, 3, 5, 9)))

grid_pred_2 <- insight::get_datagrid(x=subset(m_dHA4d_d,
                                            select=-c(StimNum, dHighlyAnnoyedProp)),
  by=list(UASLoudECMAPowAvg=UASLoudECMAPowAvg_swp,
          Experiment=0, UASEvents=c(1, 2, 3, 5, 9)))

m_dHA4d_bt_pred_1 <- predict(m_dHA4d_boot, newdata = grid_pred_1,
                           model=m_dHA4d_deploy, target = 'deployed')

m_dHA4d_bt_pred_2 <- predict(m_dHA4d_boot, newdata = grid_pred_2,
                           model=m_dHA4d_deploy, target = 'deployed')

m_dHA4d_predict <- predict.glmmTMB.ordbeta(m_dHA4d, newdata=stimDataNoAmb, type='response')

m_dHA4d_dep_predict <- m_dHA4d_deploy(stimDataNoAmb)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp - m_dHA4d_dep_predict)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp -
                                                                                      mean(stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m_dHA4d_dep_predict,
                     measured_target='dHighlyAnnoyedProp', measured_ci_low='dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_High', fitted='estimate')

R2_cv <- subset(cv_m_dHA4d[['summary']], target=="deployed" & metric == "R2")['cv_mean']
RMSE_CV <- subset(cv_m_dHA4d[['summary']], target=="deployed" & metric == "RMSE")['cv_mean']

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=merge(m_dHA4d_boot[['predictions']][, c('StimNum', 'estimate', 'lower', 'upper')],
                  data.frame(Experiment = stimDataNoAmb[['Experiment']],
                             StimNum = stimDataNoAmb[['StimNum']],
                             response = stimDataNoAmb[['dHighlyAnnoyedProp']],
                             responseCI_Low = stimDataNoAmb[['dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_Low']],

                  by = "StimNum")) +

        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, colour=Experiment, shape=Experiment), size=1.75, stroke=0.75, alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate, colour=Experiment), width=0, alpha=0.1) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=lower, ymax=upper, colour=Experiment), width=0, alpha=0.1) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(values=mycolours[1:2], name="Experiment", guide=guide_legend(ncol = 2, position = 'top')) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(4, 0), name="Experiment", guide=guide_legend(ncol = 2, position = 'top')) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10)) +
  
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(-0.05, 1.05), ylim=c(-0.05, 1.05), expand=FALSE) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")), y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.05, y=1, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.05, y=0.925, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)[CV]^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2_cv, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
```

### analyse deployment performance

```{r}

m_dHA5e_boot <- boot_mean_model(deployed=m_dHA5e_deploy,
                                trial_data=subjDataNoAmb.med,
                               cluster='PersonNum', response='dHighlyAnnoyed',
                               stat = 'mean', by = 'StimNum',
                               strata = 'Experiment', resample = 'clusters',
                               stimulus_strata = 'Experiment',
                               response_transform = NULL,
                               jitter_step=1, interval = 'bc',
                               jitter_rows = NULL,
                               recentre='mean', regrid=NULL, newdata = NULL,
                               B = 2000, level = 0.95,
                               prediction_intervals = FALSE, pi_draws = 10L,
                               parallel = TRUE, seed = 999, verbose = TRUE)

cv_m_dHA5e <- cv_mean_model(m_dHA5e_deploy, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps, strata = 'Experiment',
                            group = 'StimNum', seed = 1, parallel = TRUE)

UASLAE_swp <- seq(min(stimDataNoAmb[['UASLAEMaxLR']]),
                      max(stimDataNoAmb[['UASLAEMaxLR']]),
                      length.out=20)

AmbLAF10_cats <- c(49, 58, 61, 68, 71)

grid_pred_1 <- insight::get_datagrid(x=subset(m_dHA5e_d,
                                            select=-c(StimNum, dHighlyAnnoyedProp)),
  by=list(UASLAEMaxLR=UASLAE_swp,
          AmbLAF10ExMaxLR=AmbLAF10_cats,
          Experiment=0, UASEvents=c(1, 2, 3, 5, 9)))

grid_pred_2 <- insight::get_datagrid(x=subset(m_dHA5e_d,
                                            select=-c(StimNum, dHighlyAnnoyedProp)),
  by=list(UASLAEMaxLR=UASLAE_swp,
          Experiment=0, UASEvents=c(1, 2, 3, 5, 9)))

m_dHA5e_bt_pred_1 <- predict(m_dHA5e_boot, newdata = grid_pred_1,
                           model=m_dHA5e_deploy, target = 'deployed')

m_dHA5e_bt_pred_2 <- predict(m_dHA5e_boot, newdata = grid_pred_2,
                           model=m_dHA5e_deploy, target = 'deployed')

m_dHA5e_predict <- predict.glmmTMB.ordbeta(m_dHA5e, newdata=stimDataNoAmb, type='response')

m_dHA5e_dep_predict <- m_dHA5e_deploy(stimDataNoAmb)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp - m_dHA5e_dep_predict)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp -
                                                                                      mean(stimDataNoAmb$dHighlyAnnoyedProp))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m_dHA5e_dep_predict,
                     measured_target='dHighlyAnnoyedProp', measured_ci_low='dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_High', fitted='estimate')

R2_cv <- subset(cv_m_dHA5e[['summary']], target=="deployed" & metric == "R2")['cv_mean']
RMSE_CV <- subset(cv_m_dHA5e[['summary']], target=="deployed" & metric == "RMSE")['cv_mean']

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=merge(m_dHA5e_boot[['predictions']][, c('StimNum', 'estimate', 'lower', 'upper')],
                  data.frame(Experiment = stimDataNoAmb[['Experiment']],
                             StimNum = stimDataNoAmb[['StimNum']],
                             response = stimDataNoAmb[['dHighlyAnnoyedProp']],
                             responseCI_Low = stimDataNoAmb[['dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_Low']],
                             responseCI_High = stimDataNoAmb[['dHighlyAnnoyedPropCI_High']]),
                  by = "StimNum")) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, colour=Experiment, shape=Experiment), size=1.75, stroke=0.75, alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate, colour=Experiment), width=0, alpha=0.1) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=lower, ymax=upper, colour=Experiment), width=0, alpha=0.1) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(values=mycolours[1:2], name="Experiment", guide=guide_legend(ncol = 2, position = 'top')) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(4, 0), name="Experiment", guide=guide_legend(ncol = 2, position = 'top')) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10)) +
  
  coord_cartesian(xlim=c(-0.05, 1.05), ylim=c(-0.05, 1.05), expand=FALSE) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")),
       y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.05, y=1, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.05, y=0.925, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)[CV]^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2_cv, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.05, y=0.85, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.05, y = 0.775, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE) +
ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.05, y = 0.7, label = paste0("RMSE[CV] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(RMSE_CV, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)
```

```{r}
  recentre='mean', regrid=NULL, newdata = NULL,

m_dHA6b_bt_pred <- predict(m_dHA6b_boot, newdata = grid_pred,

                  by = "StimNum")) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, colour=Experiment, shape=Experiment), size=1.75, stroke=0.75, alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate, colour=Experiment), width=0, alpha=0.1) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=lower, ymax=upper, colour=Experiment), width=0, alpha=0.1) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(values=mycolours[1:2], name="Experiment", guide=guide_legend(ncol = 2, position = 'top')) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(4, 0), name="Experiment", guide=guide_legend(ncol = 2, position = 'top')) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10)) +

  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")), y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.05, y=1, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.05, y=0.925, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)[CV]^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2_cv, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.05, y=0.85, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +

  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE) +
```

## S7: Detectability and UAS events

### formula

```{r}

m_dHA7a_f <- dHighlyAnnoyedProp ~ Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLR + I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.105917955) +
  Experiment

m_dHA7a_d <- stimDataNoAmb[, c(StimNum='StimNum',
                             all.vars(m_dHA7a_f)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(dHighlyAnnoyedProp))

m_dHA7b_f <- dHighlyAnnoyedProp ~ Detect0p5dBIntEx50MaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents) - 0.105917955) +
  Experiment

m_dHA7b_d <- stimDataNoAmb[, c(StimNum='StimNum',
                             all.vars(m_dHA7b_f)), drop=FALSE] |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(dHighlyAnnoyedProp))

```

### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m_dHA7a <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(formula=m_dHA7a_f, dispformula= ~ Experiment,
                          data=m_dHA7a_d,
                          family=glmmTMB::ordbeta(link='logit'),
                          control=glmmTMBctrl)

m_dHA7b <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(formula=m_dHA7b_f, dispformula= ~ Experiment,
                          data=m_dHA7b_d,
                          family=glmmTMB::ordbeta(link='logit'),
                          control=glmmTMBctrl)

parameters::model_parameters(m_dHA7a, dispersion=TRUE)
parameters::model_parameters(m_dHA7b, dispersion=TRUE)

performance::compare_performance(m_dHA1a, m_dHA2d, m_dHA3a, m_dHA4d, m_dHA5e,
                                 m_dHA6b, m_dHA7a, m_dHA7b)

```

### compare CV performance

```{r}

cv_m_dHA7a <- cv_mean_model(m_dHA7a, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps,
                           strata = 'Experiment', group = 'StimNum',
                           seed = 1, parallel = TRUE)

cv_m_dHA7b <- cv_mean_model(m_dHA7b, k = k_fold, reps = cv_reps,
                           strata = 'Experiment', group = 'StimNum',
                           seed = 1, parallel = TRUE)

compare_mean_models(m_dHA7a=cv_m_dHA7a, m_dHA7b=cv_m_dHA7b)

```

### generate deployment version

```{r}

m_dHA7a_deploy <- deploy_mean_model(m_dHA7a,
                                   scaling_data = stimDataNoAmb,
                                   Experiment=0, coef_simplify=T, verbose=TRUE)

```
